page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.t5-c1m4.large is a burstable virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture with an Intel Xeon 8163 processor operating at 2.5 GHz. The hardware configuration includes 2 vCPUs derived from 1 physical core with hyper-threading enabled, paired with 8.0 GB of system memory. This instance does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, and operates with a baseline network bandwidth of 0 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates that this instance is positioned in the lower performance tiers. In stress-ng testing, single-core CPU performance scored 1057.79, while multi-core performance reached 2090.03, placing both metrics in the weak and poor categories respectively. Memory bandwidth tests show a cached read-only speed of 150.43 GB/sec, dropping to 16.3 GB/sec for uncached large block reads. Geekbench results align with this profile, yielding a single-core score of 870.0 and a multi-core score of 1493.0.

As a burstable instance, the ecs.t5-c1m4.large offers a cost-effective entry point for workloads that do not require sustained high CPU utilization. The primary tradeoff is the burstable CPU allocation model, which limits continuous high-performance execution once CPU credits are exhausted. This makes it highly resource-dense and budget-friendly for intermittent tasks, but unsuitable for sustained compute-heavy operations.

Given its hardware constraints and benchmark performance, this instance is best suited for low-traffic web serving, development and testing environments, lightweight background tasks, and basic database operations with low transactional volume, such as Redis instances handling moderate request rates.
